crossRefs.note: Behold, because Yahweh has given you the Sabbath, therefore he gives you on the sixth day the bread of two days.…
Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

parallels.note: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

translations.web: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter, nor on a Sabbath,
translations.bsb: Pray that your flight will not occur in the winter or on the Sabbath.
translations.kjv: But pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on the sabbath day:
translations.asv: And pray ye that your flight be not in the winter, neither on a sabbath:
